answer_1.quote: This line of research is known as Conversational Question Generation (CQG), which targets generating questions given the context and conversational history.

answer_2.quote: We utilise BERTScore as our dialog entailment metric (BERTScore-entailment)... To measure the relevance between the generated conversation and the context, we concatenate the generated QA pairs and compute the BERTScore... We further provide Jumping Score (JS) to measure the flexibility of the generated conversation.

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation is critical to evaluate the quality of the generated conversations... We hire three annotators who are English native speakers.
answer_4.guideline: Each generated question is rated by annotators on a 1-3 scale (3 is the best). We follow to utilize three criteria: (1) Factuality measures the factual correctness and meaning of generated questions, (2) Conversational Alignment measures how aligned the generated questions are with the history, (3) Answerability measures how answerable the generated questions are by the given context.
